$comment: Chains and tiers for tools/gate-run.mjs (docs/GATES.md). Paths: 'run:<rel>' = the runner's run worktree (a shard's own), 'src:<rel>' = this checkout, ${RUN} ${SRC} ${MAIN} ${OUT} expand in env and links (${OUT} is the shard's evidence dir). Every client script here forces the stub or the sim sidecar; the runner refuses others. Step fields: estMin (measured minutes, for --plan), resources (steps sharing a resource never overlap; 'bench' = the step runs alone: its bars are timing/MSPT), restore (prepared worlds cloned from the snapshot store before the step), after (needs that step's PASS, same shard), stopOnFail (a barrier: nothing else starts until it passes).

slots.$comment: Machine-wide gate-run slots (docs/GATES.md): at most max runs at once; --slots N overrides.

shards.$comment: --shards N (at most max). Each shard has its own run worktree (shard 1: --run-dir/GATE_RUN_DIR; shard k: <run dir>-s<k>, or --run-dirs) and port pair (--ports S:D,S:D,... / GATE_PORTS; no default for shards 2..: name them, several agents share the machine). 8892-8895 are never a shard's: the gates' old-version clients and eval sidecars use them.

snapshots.$comment: Prepared worlds a step restores (APFS clone, cp -c -R) from the snapshot store instead of regenerating; the store is the seed's saves (GATE_SNAPSHOT_DIR overrides). Restoring also undoes whatever an earlier step or run left in that world.

tiers.$comment: The three tiers (docs/GATES.md). change = the unit suites + the impact map's change steps (minutes; a docs-only diff runs nothing); slice = the unit suites + apijars + the change and slice steps of the impact, i.e. the slice's own gate steps found by its driver's impact rule, and no quick (policy 2026-10-12; engineSlice is added on engine-touching diffs, empty: the full mega_bench waits for release); release = everything, unattended overnight, with the duplicates rotated deterministically by the rotation key (--release <tag>: the tag's index among the version-sorted v* tags; else the ISO week), then the full independent gate-verifier.

rotate.name: crash suite
rotate.why: one crash suite per release, alternating 4e and 6a

rotate.name: megaB
rotate.why: megaB every release: the full walk on engine-touching releases, else alternating full / --fast

rotate.name: heap
rotate.why: the capped-heap mega_bench every other release (opposite to the full megaB)

rotate.name: throughput
rotate.why: warm-up + median of 3 only on releases touching realise or placement, else one run as a smoke test

notes: E-flat (6a-eflat) runs every release; E-normal is asserted inside megaA (the diff after its group undo), so megaA every release covers it.
mega-lite (4e-megalite, 256x256) is in every tier; the full 1000x1000 mega_bench: megaA at every release and in slices whose diff touches region code (the impact map), megaB only at release.

impact.$comment: Change-impact map (tools/gate-impact.mjs): every rule matching a changed path counts. change: steps a `change` run picks; slice: extra steps a `slice` run adds (on top of quick and the change steps); tags: engine (realise, the journal, regions, tiles, the undo: slices add tiers.slice.engineSlice; releases run the full megaB), placement (realise/placement throughput: releases run the full throughput). A path no rule covers is UNMAPPED: change falls back to every unit suite, and it is printed. Extend the map when a slice adds a package or a gate step.

6c Y2 waiting status and full BOM (slice Y2)
6c T1 passes, fields and relief (slice T1)
